items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: I went out there with Eddie... And we -- and then we came back to New York and played the Three Deuces I think. We went back again and then came back again and played the Cafe Society Uptown.

ctx.x: Yeah. Now, yeah, it's always been interesting to me about you in a certain time in your career when you were playing like with Beth Shay (PHONETIC) and you played what some people might call Dixieland and -- I don't like the word anyway. And then you turn around and play with Lester and, you know --
